paper_citation: Yang, J. et al. Spotiphy enables single-cell spatial whole transcriptomics across an entire section. Nat Methods (2025).
notes: Gold claims are scorer-only and scoped to the AD mouse-brain spatial case. Agents must never see this file.

claims.statement: Inferred single-cell / high-resolution spatial profiles reveal regional specification of astrocytes across mouse brain regions.
Disease-associated microglia (DAM) show spatially restricted programs in Alzheimer’s disease model brains relative to healthy controls / non-plaque regions.
Spatial domains defined by cellular composition and transcriptomic profiles organize tissue architecture across the whole section.
